[SWS_ComM_00303]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09071
⌈If the current state is COMM_FULL_COM_NETWORK_REQUESTED and when mode limi-
tation to COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION has been requested for the corresponding chan-
nel, ComM module shall switch to COMM_FULL_COM_READY_SLEEP state to initiate a
shutdown despite any user requests for COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION.⌋
Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00303]: Forcing into COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION mode is
needed to shut down software components, which keeps the bus awake.
Comment for [SWS_ComM_00303]: Limit to COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION will only
be performed if a channel was request actively.
In that case all current user
requests for full communication or even new requests will be ignored (see also
